entries.claim: Disabling a mode erases all immutable proposals held by callers.
entries.resolution: Specification corrected: disable rejects subsequent admissions; retained proposals never carry order authority. No production revocation implementation is claimed.

entries.claim: The legacy loader always compares against the expected provenance captured before artifact I/O.
entries.resolution: Private canonical expected identity captured and validated before I/O; old loader preserved in formal/research/artifact-legacy-loader.json

entries.claim: The legacy bot-start fork cannot initialize before its runtime-map entry is committed.
entries.resolution: Private child gate rejects on failed publication and accepts only after masked runtime-map commit. Legacy ordering adapter deterministically reproduces the failure without trading.

entries.claim: A fresh report directory alone prevents truncation of colliding existing files or linked champion data.
entries.resolution: Exclusive binary create at every actual report leaf rejects regular-file, symlink and hardlink collisions, preserving old bytes. New partial output is not a durable complete archive.

entries.claim: A positive two-decision likelihood-ratio trajectory always retains a nonzero weight under binary64 cumulative multiplication.
trace: binary64 product becomes0 despite each ratio being positive
v2 exact product remains positive; ESS1 and WIS2 for rewards (1,1), gamma1
entries.resolution: Exact conversion before ratio/product, bounded rational recurrences through complete descriptive estimates; frozen v1 remains unchanged and invalid for adoption.

entries.claim: Exclusive report file creation alone implies interrupted report export can resume in the same directory.
trace: legacy default creates fresh report directory
injected failure writes first3 bytes of first report
retry rejects the existing directory; partial output remains
entries.resolution: Preserve legacy default semantics; opt-in v2 encodes a complete bundle, fsyncs staging bytes, publishes an exclusive link, then fsyncs the parent. Retry validates matching bytes and preserves target identity. Training archives are not repaired.

entries.claim: A deliberately injected score-only Research-to-Shadow edge preserves mandatory-stage safety.
entries.resolution: The source-derived model excludes this edge because actual decoders accept only Research. The mutant must fail; no runtime promotion is added and no historical runtime defect is claimed.

entries.claim: A finite model that carries the previous eligibility stage unchanged detects a promoted writer tag.
entries.resolution: Compute save/load stage from source-derived metadata. The independent source/SMT guard already rejected the bad tag; no actual runtime defect or formerly accepted complete proof is claimed.
